_note: Laptop brands/models. 'verified': true means every spec was checked against published listings for that exact SKU. 'verified': false means a family-level seed entry from general knowledge: the UI must ask the user to CONFIRM every spec instead of auto-filling. Nothing here may be invented: when unsure, leave a field out and the form will ask or allow 'Unknown'. 'fixed' specs are never asked when present. 'variants' are the hardware configurations the user must choose between; a single variant is pre-selected and shown for confirmation. 'upgradable' marks specs users commonly change after purchase and may correct.
